title: Filipino Pork Toccino
description: Sweet, caramelized pork — juicy, tender, and perfect for a classic Filipino breakfast.

method.instruction: Slice pork shoulder into 1/4-inch thick pieces.
Combine brown sugar, pineapple juice, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, salt, pepper, and food coloring in a bowl.
Add pork to the mixture and marinate for 24 hours in the refrigerator.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-low heat.
Cook pork for 10–12 minutes, flipping every minute until caramelized on both sides.
Serve with garlic fried rice (sinangag), fried eggs, or plain rice.

notes.title: Tips & Serving
notes.content: Marinate overnight for maximum flavor. Cook gently to avoid burning sugars. Serve as “Tocilog” with garlic rice and fried egg.

notes.title: Tips & Serving
notes.content: Variations: Try chicken tocino or use natural coloring like annatto or beet juice. Adjust sweetness or tanginess to taste.

notes.title: Tips & Serving
notes.content: FAQ: Skip food coloring if desired. Marinate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. Cook low and slow to retain juiciness.
